words.name: CURSOR-ORIGIN

words.name: CURSOR-GRID-POS

words.name: CURSOR-GRID-STEP

words.name: CURSOR-GRID-LIMIT

words.name: CURSOR-MOVE-DELTA

words.name: CURSOR-PIXEL

words.name: STEP-CURSOR

words.name: JOYSTICK-TRIGGER

words.name: INIT-CURSOR-PLAYERS

words.name: CURSOR-ORIGIN!
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Sets vertical origin y+$21 and horizontal origin 4*x+$32 in the axis-indexed cursor array.

words.name: CURSOR-LIMITS!

words.name: CURSOR-STEPS!

words.name: VIEW-STACK
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Counted stack of 16-bit view IDs; the first byte counts stored bytes. $517D pushes and $51AA pops.

words.name: PUSH-VIEW
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Stores the cell at VIEW-STACK+count+2, then increments the byte count by two. This implementation has no capacity check.

words.name: P

words.name: POP-VIEW
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Fetches the cell at VIEW-STACK+count, then decrements a nonzero byte count by two; zero count returns the initial cell.

words.name: CELL-ARRAY:
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Defining word allocates twice the requested count; DOES> doubles the index and adds it to the payload.

words.name: VIEW-CURSOR-POSITIONS
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Cell array stores one cursor x/y byte pair for each view-stack byte-count index, as used by $5204/$5220.

words.name: RESTORE-VIEW-CURSOR
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Indexes saved cursor cells by current VIEW-STACK byte count, fetches the packed pair and writes it to the horizontal/vertical cursor bytes.

words.name: SAVE-VIEW-CURSOR
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Stores the current packed cursor position at the cell-array index given by the current VIEW-STACK byte count.

words.name: CENTER-VIEW-CURSOR
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Uses active hit-map dimensions: y becomes height/2 and x becomes width/2-1.

words.name: CONFIGURE-VIEW-CURSOR
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Uses picture origin for a zoom view or x4/y0 for the base view, applies active hit-map dimensions as limits and fixes cursor steps to4/6 pixels.

words.name: HIT-MAP-CELL
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Returns the hit-map byte at base+2+x+y*width for the currently selected map.

words.name: HIT-MAP-OFFSET
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Adds horizontal picture offset and stride*(vertical offset/6), matching six bitmap rows per hit-map row.

words.name: EXPAND-HIT-MAP
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Decodes a packed width/height hit-map record at its relative picture offset into the active hit-map buffer.

words.name: LOAD-BASE-HIT-MAP
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Selects the base map, copies its dimensions (doubling width), configures/centers the cursor and expands the packed map.

words.name: LOAD-ZOOM-HIT-MAP
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Selects the zoom map, copies its width/height header and expands its packed payload.

words.name: OVERLAY-HIT-MAP
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Resolves a mask resource and expands it into the current hit map using the current picture offsets.

words.name: MASK-PICTURE-BYTE
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Native helper processes four two-bit pixels, combines a source-pixel mask with destination, and tracks runs through $FC. Returns masked byte in $FA with RTS.
words.calling_convention: Assembly subroutine entry; returns with RTS.

words.name: BLIT-MASKED
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Zero makes $538D copy source directly; nonzero enables masked blending with the optional hit/depth comparison.

words.name: BLEND-PICTURE-BYTE
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Copies a source pixel byte directly when BLIT-MASKED is zero; otherwise calls $5346, ORs source pixels with the masked background and stores them. This game has no Klatwa hit/depth threshold branch. Native RTS.
words.calling_convention: Assembly subroutine entry; returns with RTS.

words.name: BLEND-PICTURE-ROW
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Calls the byte blending helper for Y=0 through width-1, width held in $F7. Native RTS helper.
words.calling_convention: Assembly subroutine entry; returns with RTS.

words.name: BLEND-PICTURE-ROWS
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: For each row, clears the pixel-run counter, blends width bytes, advances source and destination by their independent strides, then decrements height. No Klatwa row clipping or hit-map pointer progression remains. Native RTS.
words.calling_convention: Assembly subroutine entry; returns with RTS.

words.name: BLIT-PICTURE
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Preserves the Forth stack register while invoking the native rectangle compositor at $53C3.

words.name: PICTURE-SCREEN-ADDR
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Reads picture x/y and returns BITMAP-BASE+x+40*y.

words.name: BLIT-PARAMETERS
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Stores destination stride, source pointer and width/height/source stride, then calls the native blitter. Header begins with width/height.

words.name: DRAW-DECODED-PICTURE
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Converts the picture's x/y header into its screen address, sets destination pointer and blits width/height pixels with40-byte screen stride.

words.name: COMPOSE-STAGED-PICTURE
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Uses staged picture and $0600 scene headers to calculate relative offsets, then blits the staged image into the scene buffer using scene width as destination stride.

words.name: SCENE-BACKUP-PICTURE
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Constant $0A00 is a four-byte picture header followed by a saved screen rectangle used when entering/leaving zoom views.

words.name: SAVE-SCENE-BACKGROUND
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Copies the scene picture header to $0A00 and captures its screen rectangle using40-byte source stride and the blitter; unlike Klatwa, it performs no extra banked backup.

words.name: ITEM-RESOURCE-BASE
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Constant $8D4D is the normal-RAM base of item-art u16-length resources, indexed by $54F2.

words.name: ITEM-RESOURCE-ADDR
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Indexes the item-art length-record collection at $9932.

words.name: SAVED-STATE-BASE
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Start of the contiguous saved state copied by game load/save; initial cells2 and10 precede CURRENT-ROOM and the power-slot records. No more specific direct reader is established.

words.name: CURRENT-ROOM
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Room cell set by $59F0 and read by room/view list selection, achievements and high-level game actions.

words.name: POWER-SLOT-RECORDS
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Eight length-prefixed power records contain three metadata bytes plus13 display-name bytes. $603C renders SPIS MOCY; $61F2 checks the selected power and two inventory requirements; $6294 installs matching or empty slot metadata.

words.name: ITEM-POSITIONS
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Cell array of saved item x/y pairs. $5898 indexes it by objectID-$CA and installs these coordinates before drawing a dropped item.

words.name: PART2-ITEM-POSITIONS
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Initial item x/y coordinate table copied into the live ITEM-POSITIONS table when beginning the second part.

words.name: CURRENT-PART-GROUP
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Selects the game-part resource group. Start/load paths set2 or4; saved-game loading derives group4 or6 by adding two.

words.name: w563E
words.evidence: Unknown erased name; CFA identifier

words.name: ROOM-OBJECT-STATE
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Mutable nested u16-length room/view object records. $59DC takes room/view and returns the selected list; scene redraw and object-changing actions consume these records.

words.name: w57D6
words.evidence: Unknown erased name; CFA identifier

words.name: ROOM-ACHIEVEMENT-BITS
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Room-indexed achievement bit bytes updated and counted by progress routines. The buffer contains25 active room bytes plus padding; game actions set particular event bits.

words.name: PUZZLE-STATE-CELLS
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Indexed puzzle-state cell array shared by power, object and ending actions. Consumers treat its entries as independent flags/counters; no single narrower meaning covers the whole array.

words.name: PATH-X
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Movement handlers update this coordinate for the path puzzle; used with PATH-Y and directional move counters.

words.name: PATH-Y
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Movement handlers update this coordinate for the path puzzle; used with PATH-X and directional move counters.

words.name: PATH-MOVES-LEFT
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Cell initially12, adjusted by the path-movement handlers as the puzzle move budget.

words.name: PATH-LAST-DIRECTION
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Cell initially1; path handlers record previous direction here for their movement constraints.

words.name: PATH-DIRECTION-COUNTS
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Four16-bit direction counters, initially5,2,0,3, updated by the path-movement handlers $7E82..$7ECC.

words.name: LAST-DIRECTION
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Previous movement direction cell used by ordinary navigation and retained in the saved state; separate from the path puzzle's direction at $585A.

words.name: ITEM-PICTURE-INDEX
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Maps an inventory/drop object ID to its picture resource: 2*(object-$CA)+2, followed by its paired mask resource.

words.name: COMPOSE-DROPPED-ITEM
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Enables masked blending, decodes item art, applies the saved ITEM-POSITIONS coordinates, composes it into the scene and expands its paired hit map, then disables masked blending.

words.name: DRAW-BASE-PICTURE
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Draws the selected picture directly to screen and loads the next resource as its base hit map.

words.name: DRAW-PICTURE-AND-MASK
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Draws the picture; only if the word after its length-bounded payload is nonzero does it expand the next resource as a hit-map overlay.

words.name: DECODE-ZOOM-PICTURE
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Decodes a picture into the scene buffer and loads the following resource as the zoom hit map.

words.name: COMPOSE-PICTURE-AND-MASK
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Overlays a picture in the scene buffer, then expands its following mask resource into the selected hit map.

words.name: ROOM-RECORD-BUFFER
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Constant $8CC1 is the normal-RAM room descriptor staging buffer. Background drawing loads a nested record here before choosing its graphics resources.

words.name: SPLIT-OBJECT-ID
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Divides by100, doubles the quotient for the resource collection number and retains the remainder as the local object index.

words.name: CLASSIFY-OBJECT
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: IDs0/1 produce only0; IDs above200 retain the original ID and return1 (item art); IDs2..200 load the collection selected by ID/100 and return local index followed by class2 (scene art). Stack arity therefore differs for ignored IDs.

words.name: DRAW-OBJECT-LIST
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Walks object bytes in a u16-length record beginning at start; classifies each ID and draws its picture/mask when nonzero.

words.name: DRAW-ROOM-BACKGROUND
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Fetches room-1 from nested collection1 into ROOM-RECORD-BUFFER, loads its specified resource group, draws base picture0 and remaining static object entries.

words.name: ROOM-VIEW-OBJECTS
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Indexes outer ROOM-OBJECT-STATE by room, skips its u16 header, then indexes the selected view's u16-length object list.

words.name: DRAW-ROOM
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Stores CURRENT-ROOM, draws its static background, then draws the mutable object list for base view0.

words.name: EXPAND-THREE-BYTE-ROW
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Native helper expands a three-byte template across a wider destination row: first and last bytes are borders, middle byte repeats. Returns RTS.
words.calling_convention: Assembly subroutine entry; returns with RTS.

words.name: ADVANCE-EXPANDED-ROW
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Adds destination width $F7 to $F0/$F1 through the RLE source-pointer increment helper; native RTS.
words.calling_convention: Assembly subroutine entry; returns with RTS.

words.name: ADVANCE-ROW-TEMPLATE
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Adds three to template pointer $F2/$F3; native RTS.
words.calling_convention: Assembly subroutine entry; returns with RTS.

words.name: EXPAND-SIX-ROWS
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Repeats the three-byte row expansion six times, decrementing remaining height and advancing both pointers; native RTS.
words.calling_convention: Assembly subroutine entry; returns with RTS.

words.name: EXPAND-PICTURE-FRAME
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Expands the first six template rows, repeats the middle six-row strip, then adds a final strip; used to frame zoom pictures.

words.name: PREPARE-ZOOM-FRAME
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Fetches an object's four-byte geometry, enlarges it by two columns and12 rows, clears/configures the zoom hit map, then expands a repeated border around the scene picture.

words.name: COMPOSE-OBJECT-LIST
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Walks the byte list range; item-class IDs use dropped-item composition and scene-class IDs use picture/mask composition.

words.name: COMPOSE-VIEW
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Gets the current room's view list, prepares its first object's zoom frame, then composes every listed object into it.

words.name: RESTORE-SCENE-BACKGROUND
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Draws the saved background picture at $0A00 through DRAW-DECODED-PICTURE. The extra banked byte restore present in Klatwa is absent.

words.name: PUSH-AND-DRAW-VIEW
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Composes the view, saves the base background when entering the first zoom, pushes its ID, draws its picture and configures its cursor.

words.name: ENTER-VIEW
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Saves current cursor position, invokes $5B8D and centers the new view cursor.

words.name: REDRAW-CURRENT-VIEW
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Fetches top view ID through P, recomposes it and draws the scene picture.

words.name: LEAVE-VIEW
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Pops/discards the current view; redraws the preceding zoom or restores the base background, then reconfigures/restores its cursor.

words.name: ENTER-INVENTORY-VIEW
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Saves any active zoom background/cursor, pushes view1 and composes its special room0/view1 object list before drawing and configuring the cursor.

words.name: LEAVE-INVENTORY-VIEW
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Pops inventory view, restores base background, then rebuilds the preceding nested views and restores saved cursor coordinates.

words.name: LOAD-ITEM-ART-ENABLED
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: When nonzero, $5C88 loads the following resource group into ITEM-RESOURCE-BASE after the main banked group succeeds.

words.name: LOAD-PART-RESOURCES
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Loads up to120 sectors into logical bank offset0; if item-art loading is enabled, also loads60 sectors of the next group into item-art RAM. Retries on disk failure.

words.name: KEYBOARD-SELECTION
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Input wait stores the one-based key-list match here. A nonzero value also ends the wait even if the trigger is not pressed.

words.name: KEYBOARD-SHORTCUTS-ENABLED
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Multiplier applied to the raw key-list match in input wait; zero suppresses keyboard selection.

words.name: BASE-VIEW-KEYS-ENABLED
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Together with an empty view stack, gates whether input wait interprets the shortcut key list; high-level modal screens change this flag.

words.name: WAIT-TRIGGER-RELEASE
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Repeatedly samples active-low controller0 trigger with five-frame pauses until released.

words.name: SHORTCUT-KEYCODES
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Three bytes at body address $5D22 are raw CH keycodes21,05,28; input wait searches them directly. The saved DOCOL field is not executed.
words.calling_convention: Data body referenced by literal address; do not execute its saved DOCOL entry.

words.name: WAIT-GAME-INPUT
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Clears CH, initializes cursor players, waits for trigger release, applies controller0 movements and shortcut keys until trigger/key selection, then returns the grid x/y bytes and disables players.

words.name: DEFAULT-GAME-COLORS
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Initial color bytes copied into GAME-COLOR-TABLE by $5E1A, with the seventh byte used for COLPF3 shadow.

words.name: INSTALL-GAME-COLORS
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Points the DLI at GAME-COLOR-TABLE, enables two display-list interrupt bits, installs the handler and writes COLPF3 shadow.

words.name: RESET-GAME-COLORS
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Copies seven default color bytes to the live table and installs the game's color DLI.

words.name: AUDIO-RESOURCE-ANCHOR
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Constant $8CB9 is the anchor from which gameplay CMC module location is calculated; $5FBB subtracts $076C to select actual module address $854D.

words.name: CMC-MODULE-ADDRESS
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Cell supplied as X/Y to CMC command $70 by $5E81; stores the module load address.

words.name: SAVED-DMA-CONTROL
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Receives the previous Atari SDMCTL $022F value before display DMA is disabled.

words.name: DISPLAY-OFF
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Saves SDMCTL $022F and writes zero to disable display DMA.

words.name: RESTORE-DISPLAY
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Restores the saved value of SDMCTL $022F.

words.name: INITIALIZE-AUDIO
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Native routine passes the audio data address and initialization selector to the embedded player entry $3003.

words.name: CMC-SONG-NUMBER
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Low byte is supplied in X to CMC command0 by $5EAA; PLAY-MUSIC stores its requested song here.

words.name: START-CMC-SONG
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Preserves Forth X, invokes dispatcher $3003 with A=0 and song number in X, restores X and returns NEXT.

words.name: SELECT-AUDIO-SEQUENCE
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Stores the requested audio sequence then invokes the embedded player via the adjacent native helper.

words.name: STOP-AUDIO
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Native call to embedded player $3003 with selector $40; called when the title is skipped.

words.name: MUSIC-PAUSED
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Console-key music handler toggles this byte when pausing/resuming CMC playback.

words.name: UPDATE-CMC-MUSIC
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: VBI-callable native routine checks CONSOL: value3 sends stop command$40 and sets pause flag; value5 sends resume$60 and clears it. Always calls player frame routine$3006 before RTS.
words.calling_convention: Assembly subroutine entry; returns with RTS.

words.name: CMC-EFFECT-PARAMETERS
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Two bytes passed as X/Y to CMC command$21 by $5F30.

words.name: PLAY-CMC-EFFECT
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Preserves Forth X, calls CMC dispatcher with A=$21 and parameter bytes X/Y from $5F26, then returns NEXT.

words.name: CMC-EFFECT!
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Stores the two bytes in CMC-EFFECT-PARAMETERS then invokes PLAY-CMC-EFFECT.

words.name: SOUND-EFFECT-TABLE
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Cell array of paired CMC effect bytes. PLAY-SOUND-EFFECT at $5F9C indexes an effect, reads its two parameters and invokes CMC-EFFECT!.

words.name: PLAY-SOUND-EFFECT
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: When MUSIC-PAUSED is nonzero, indexes SOUND-EFFECT-TABLE, fetches its byte pair and calls CMC-EFFECT!; otherwise discards the effect number.

words.name: SET-GAME-MUSIC-ADDRESS
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Subtracts $076C from AUDIO-RESOURCE-ANCHOR ($8CB9), storing $854D as the CMC module address for gameplay.

words.name: INITIALIZE-GAME-DISPLAY
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Disables the display, installs game display resources and font at $BC00, initializes audio, then restores DMA.

words.name: POWER-LIST-SEPARATOR
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Prints a 26-byte decorative divider with (S"); $603C places the same divider above and below the eight power names.

words.name: SHOW-POWER-LIST
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Prints SPIS MOCY (list of powers), then four rows containing the eight $5517 records in two columns. Each name occupies 13 bytes at record+5.

words.name: ERROR-SOUND
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Calls sound dispatcher $5F9C with command19; used for wrong items, unavailable powers, forbidden actions and full inventory.

words.name: FIND-SCENE-OBJECT
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Gets a mutable room/view record through $59DC and searches its payload through $3896. Returns 0 if absent, or its byte address followed by 1 if present.

words.name: POWER-ERROR-MESSAGES
